A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same RPE research. Their text, equations, figures, tables, and complete appendices support reliable comparison despite substantial reformatting.

before.justification: v2 reports original tree and set-generation validations and experiments on TFBind, RNA, and QM9, including numerical appendix results.

after.justification: v3 retains these original empirical validations, benchmark results, and appendix tables.

M1.justification: Algorithm 3 retains uniform-policy sampling, the same reward scaling, flow parameterization, MSE objective, and derived sampling policy. Explicit loop endings and clearer descriptions do not change the procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions evaluate the same tree and set-generation examples, four TFBind rewards with tree and DAG construction, four RNA tasks, and QM9. v3 elaborates the transition modifications already acknowledged in v2.

E2.justification: Corresponding experiments retain FM, DB, TB, SubTB, soft DQN, and Munchausen DQN, including the uniform-backward-policy appendix comparison. The added soft policy iteration discussion introduces no evaluated comparator.

E3.justification: Metrics, training budgets, architectures, reward processing, and mode thresholds remain unchanged. v3 specifies the previously acknowledged transition modifications and clarifies the baseline backward policies without establishing a changed experimental protocol.

E4.justification: The tree and set-generation validations and Figure 9 comparison using uniform backward policies are retained. The new limitations discussion adds no ablation, robustness test, or error analysis.

E5.justification: Both versions report three random seeds with means and standard deviations. Uncertainty reporting in the curves and RNA tables is unchanged.

E6.justification: All plotted results and both RNA tables are retained after matching relocated figures. For example, RPE's RNA1 accuracy remains 99.81 ± 0.19 and its mode count remains 42 ± 2; the benchmark findings remain the same.

T1.justification: Theorem 4.2 explicitly restricts the flow to flow iteration with a uniform backward policy, matching the assumption already used in v2's proof. Section 2.1 also corrects the backward-policy denominator from F(s) to F(s'). The existing path-invariance condition and induction argument are retained.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion now qualify the equivalence and RPE's applicability by structural conditions. This narrows their previously broad wording to conditions already discussed in v2, while retaining the central contribution and empirical claims.

C2.justification: New Appendix D identifies separate forward passes for child states as a computational limitation and discusses potential difficulties with very long trajectories. It also expands the comparison with soft policy iteration; the existing path-invariance and HyperGrid limitations receive greater emphasis.

D1.justification: Section 5.1 and Appendix B newly specify append-only handling for the described repeated-token boundary cases, elaborating v2's unspecified transition modifications. Appendix D discloses separate forward passes for child states. Existing hardware, hyperparameters, and code-source links remain unchanged.

R1.justification: v3 adds Lee et al. (2024) and Yun et al. (2025) to the application discussion and removes Kim et al.'s temperature-conditional GFlowNet citation. Appendix D expands positioning against soft policy iteration and control-as-inference, retaining the central distinction from MaxEnt RL.

P1.justification: Targeted rewrites emphasize flow iteration and applicability conditions. Section 4 is retitled, the appendix comparison is integrated into the main discussion, and discussion, acknowledgment, and impact sections are added; the main narrative sequence remains largely intact.

P2.justification: The main text and references change from a single-column manuscript to a two-column conference layout, extensively resizing and repositioning displays. v2's appendix Figure 7 becomes main-text Figure 2 with a revised caption. The underlying figure content and table structures are retained.

improvement.justification: v3 improves precision by explicitly stating the uniform-backward assumption in Theorem 4.2, correcting the backward-policy definition, and qualifying the headline claims. Added transition details and computational limitations improve transparency. These are limited gains because the proof's underlying argument, algorithm, and empirical evidence were already present in v2.
